responsibility: This header defines the core data structures, flags, macros, and utility APIs shared across gfortran’s GENERIC translation subsystem. It introduces stmtblock_t and gfc_se for pre/post/final expression lowering state, descriptor/coarray/OpenMP-related enums and language-specific DECL/TYPE access macros, block-construction and interface-mapping services, and common prediction/runtime-check support, making it the foundational contract that expression, statement, array, declaration, intrinsic, and OpenMP lowering code all build upon.
same_name_distinction: Defines the core shared translation infrastructure—stmtblock_t, gfc_se, coarray and array-related enums, DECL/TYPE access macros, interface-mapping structures, and common utility declarations—used across the lowering subsystem. Unlike gcc/fortran/trans.cc, it does not drive translation or dispatch code generation; it provides the common contract those implementations build on.
